Copy each object in "videos" back into manifest.json "items". If the still list has changed, append the item objects to items instead; the player shuf() will re-interleave corporate and action pools.
Leave this backup file in the repo until the live restore is verified, then it can be removed in a later PR.
Do not delete any files under clips/ or on the pias-oside-tv-clips2 site.

Open a PR, merge it, bump version.txt, wait for GitHub Pages, and confirm the live manifest again contains these 23 videos and the still count is unchanged except for any stills added since the pause.
